A '''HyD modular navicomputer''', also referred to as a '''HyD modular nav computer''', was a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] from [[Microaxial/Legends|Microaxial]]. The [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] used a HyD as a backup navicomputer.
